summary: The daily answers check also compares what the readers that fold claims answer (current harness, status history, working since, timing and the rest of the checkpoint proof's readers) for every settled seat and step, so a trim that drops an older claim they fold is found

replay.detail: No claim is written or read differently; the readers run read-only once a day on a reader connection, off the request path.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged; the check reuses the proof's reader function.

compatibility.detail: Summaries carry reader/* pseudo-kinds beside claim kinds. Two members compare reader kinds only when both run fold readers, so a peer on the previous build of the check is compared by claim kinds alone, as before.

downtime.detail: No restart beyond the normal upgrade; no migration or backfill.

recovery.detail: No data recovery is needed. Reverting stops comparing the fold readers.
